# Under $15, the flat fee can cost more than 20% would.

> Free Poshmark seller fee calculator. The flat $2.95 fee under $15, 20% at $15+, the $14.75 break-even price, your real profit after item cost, and whether a lower offer costs you more than the discount. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
